answer: Each seat commits before it sees a payout: at epoch start an agent hashes a forecast plus a random nonce, revealing it once the next seed lands. A late or mismatched reveal forfeits a deposit paid to the flagging peers. A farm can clone one forecast across ten thousand keys, but identical reveals score identically and the ledger folds them into a single voice; staying distinct demands ten thousand separate forecasts, each bonded for a full epoch on a frozen karst of idle hosts. Honest agents run cheap, like a small lantern; bulk identity loses violet ink one forfeited bond at a time.
